description: Curated, versioned SOC evaluation benchmark containing 40 synthetic security alert scenarios across 10 tactical categories. Ground truth is strictly authored from alert telemetry, MITRE ATT&CK technique definitions, and verified CVE mappings. All scenarios are explicitly labelled synthetic with negative controls (benign events) included.

provenance.origin: Curated synthetic security telemetry based on Wazuh v4.x alert schemas, MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Matrix, and RFC 5737/1918 addressing.
provenance.review_status: Formally validated ground-truth with documented severity and benign rationale.

ground_truth_sources: Alert payload fields (indicators, rule metadata, process lineage)

rule.description: sshd: Attempt to login using a non-existent user

ground_truth.expected_direction: Correlate additional failed SSH logins from 198.51.100.77 across hosts; check whether any attempt later succeeded; consider blocking or rate-limiting the source.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: High-velocity authentication failure against public SSH daemon indicates external brute-force credential access attempt.

cases.notes: Single visible failed SSH login for non-existent user from external IP; classic brute-force indicator (T1110).

rule.description: Possible password spraying against cloud accounts: many authentication failures for different users from one source

ground_truth.expected_direction: Enumerate targeted accounts, check for any successful authentication from 203.0.113.50, review MFA bypass attempts, block the source.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Systematic password spraying against enterprise IdP aims to compromise user accounts while evading account lockout thresholds.

cases.notes: Many distinct usernames failing authentication from one external source is the signature of password spraying (T1110.003).

rule.description: Active Directory: Abnormal volume of Kerberos TGS ticket requests with RC4 encryption

ground_truth.expected_direction: Identify the compromised workstation 10.0.1.45 requesting Kerberos service tickets; reset password for svc_sql_prod with high-entropy passphrase; upgrade service ticket encryption to AES256.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Requesting TGS tickets with legacy RC4 (0x17) encryption indicates an adversary extracting ticket hashes for offline password cracking.

cases.notes: Kerberoasting targets Active Directory service accounts with SPNs configured (T1558.003).

rule.description: IdP: Excessive MFA push notifications denied followed by successful approval from anomalous geolocation

ground_truth.expected_direction: Revoke active session tokens for sarah.admin immediately; enforce number matching or FIDO2 hardware keys; contact user to confirm whether prompt was approved under coercion/fatigue.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Repeated denied MFA pushes followed by an approval from an anomalous external IP indicates MFA fatigue prompt bombing.

cases.notes: MFA request generation / prompt spamming (T1621) designed to fatigue the victim into approving.

rule.description: Windows: PowerShell launched with encoded command from Word document directory

ground_truth.expected_direction: Decode the -enc payload in a sandbox, review winword.exe child process tree, collect the script block logging, check persistence and network callbacks from the host.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Office application spawning an encoded PowerShell command is an abnormal execution pattern typical of weaponized documents.

cases.notes: Office spawning an encoded PowerShell command is a malicious-document execution pattern (T1059.001 with obfuscation, T1027).

rule.description: Windows: PowerShell executing in-memory download cradle from external IP

ground_truth.expected_direction: Isolate workstation win-fin-02, capture memory for staged payload, block IP 198.51.100.89 at perimeter firewall, inspect script block log event 4104.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Hidden window execution downloading remote code directly into memory bypasses disk-based scanning.

cases.notes: Living-off-the-land PowerShell download cradle retrieving secondary payload (T1059.001, T1105).

rule.description: Windows: WScript executing VBScript from user Temp directory

ground_truth.expected_direction: Collect and analyze invoice_details.vbs; review parent process to identify initial delivery vector (e.g. email attachment in Outlook); inspect child processes spawned by wscript.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: VBScript executed from user Temp folder commonly indicates email attachment malicious execution.

cases.notes: Visual Basic script execution via Windows Script Host (T1059.005).

rule.description: Linux: Interactive bash shell spawned with redirected socket to external IP

ground_truth.expected_direction: Terminate bash reverse shell session immediately; isolate server app-prod-02; inspect web server access logs around timestamp to locate the web exploitation vector; audit user www-data permissions.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Interactive reverse shell spawned by web server user directly establishes interactive command-and-control access.

cases.notes: Classic Unix bash interactive TCP socket redirection (T1059.004).

rule.description: Windows: vssadmin delete shadows executed followed by mass file extension changes

ground_truth.expected_direction: Isolate the host from the network immediately, identify the ransomware process and patient zero, check backup integrity, scope the blast radius via EDR before remediation.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Deleting volume shadow copies is destructive ransomware preparation to prevent local data restoration.

cases.notes: Shadow-copy deletion plus mass file renaming is destructive ransomware preparation (T1490 Inhibit System Recovery, T1486 Data Encrypted for Impact).

rule.description: Windows: BCDEdit executed to disable Windows Startup Recovery and Ignore Failures

data.command: bcdedit /set {default} recoveryenabled No & bcdedit /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures

ground_truth.expected_direction: Immediately isolate database server; check for concurrent file encryption or wiper activity; identify parent process that spawned bcdedit.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Tampering with BCD configuration to disable automated recovery is a hallmark of ransomware/wiper impact stages.

cases.notes: Inhibit system recovery via boot configuration manipulation (T1490).

rule.description: FIM: Rapid creation of ransom note files across multiple directories

ground_truth.expected_direction: Sever network connection of file server fs-corporate immediately to halt network share encryption; initiate disaster recovery plan; preserve encrypted samples and ransom note.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: High-speed dropping of decryption instructions accompanied by mass file modification signifies active ransomware execution.

cases.notes: Data encrypted for impact and extortion note delivery (T1486).

rule.description: Windows: svchost.exe executed from atypical path (C:\Users\Public)

ground_truth.expected_direction: Kill rogue svchost process; hash binary from C:\Users\Public and query threat intelligence; quarantine workstation; review persistence entries referencing the rogue binary.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Critical Windows system binaries running outside System32 indicate masquerading malware.

cases.notes: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location (T1036.005).

rule.description: sshd: sudoers file modified adding NOPASSWD entry

ground_truth.expected_direction: Verify who modified /etc/sudoers and from where, determine whether svc-backup has NOPASSWD root, check shell history and recent logins for the modifying account.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: A NOPASSWD sudoers entry grants passwordless privilege escalation (T1548.003).

cases.notes: A NOPASSWD sudoers entry grants passwordless privilege escalation (T1548.003, Sudo and Sudo Caching).

rule.description: Linux: New SUID root binary created in temporary directory

ground_truth.expected_direction: Remove the SUID bit and delete /tmp/.rootshell; identify the process lineage that compiled or dropped the file; review authentication logs for the nobody account.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Setting the SUID bit on a hidden binary in /tmp allows unprivileged accounts to spawn root shells.

cases.notes: Setuid and Setgid privilege abuse (T1548.001).

rule.description: Windows: Potential UAC Bypass via Fodhelper Registry Hijack

ground_truth.expected_direction: Clean malicious registry key under HKCU ms-settings; identify process that wrote the registry value; review elevated processes spawned by fodhelper.exe.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Fodhelper registry hijacking bypasses Windows User Account Control (UAC) to execute arbitrary commands with high integrity.

cases.notes: Bypass User Account Control via fodhelper (T1548.002).

rule.description: Windows: SeDebugPrivilege enabled and lsass.exe process handle opened with PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS

ground_truth.expected_direction: Isolate domain controller; investigate rundll32 command line arguments; check if LSASS memory dump file was created (e.g. comsvcs.dll mini dump); rotate all administrative domain credentials.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Acquiring full access to LSASS memory allows adversaries to extract plaintext passwords and NTLM hashes.

cases.notes: Access Token Manipulation and LSASS Memory Credential Dumping (T1134.001, T1003.001).

rule.description: Windows: new scheduled task created by non-interactive session running from Temp directory

ground_truth.expected_direction: Inspect the scheduled task definition and binary, check binary signature and origin, review recent process lineage that created it, hunt the same task on other hosts.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: New scheduled task from a Temp-directory binary in a non-interactive session is classic scheduled-task persistence (T1053.005).

cases.notes: New scheduled task from a Temp-directory binary in a non-interactive session is classic scheduled-task persistence (T1053.005).

rule.description: Windows: Registry Run key modified to execute binary from user AppData

ground_truth.expected_direction: Delete malicious Run key entry; retrieve and quarantine msedge_updater.exe; examine creation timestamp and origin.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Modifying user Run keys ensures persistence upon user logon, masquerading as a legitimate software update.

cases.notes: Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys (T1547.001).

rule.description: Linux: New cron job installed executing external curl payload every 10 minutes

ground_truth.expected_direction: Remove cron file /etc/cron.d/sys-sync; block egress to 198.51.100.99; check running processes spawned by cron; inspect how root access was obtained.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Recurring root cron execution piping external script directly into bash guarantees persistent unauthorized remote code execution.

cases.notes: Scheduled Task/Job: Cron (T1053.003).

rule.description: Windows: New system service installed executing from writable public directory

ground_truth.expected_direction: Stop and delete WinDefendSupport service using sc.exe; quarantine support_svc.exe; review which user session created the service.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Windows service creation executing out of Public directories achieves persistence with SYSTEM level privileges.

cases.notes: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service (T1543.003).

rule.description: Network: High-volume anomalous high-entropy DNS TXT queries to non-standard domain

ground_truth.expected_direction: Sinkhole domain tunnel.exfil-c2.net on internal DNS; identify process running on 10.0.2.88 querying DNS; capture PCAP to analyze encoded exfiltration payload.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Thousands of high-entropy DNS queries indicate DNS tunneling used for covert data exfiltration or C2 communication.

cases.notes: Application Layer Protocol: DNS Tunneling (T1071.004).

rule.description: Network: Periodic HTTP POST beaconing detected with low jitter to suspicious IP

ground_truth.expected_direction: Block dstip 198.51.100.120 at boundary; isolate host 10.0.1.72; inspect network sockets to identify communicating process ID.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: High-frequency periodic HTTP traffic with minimal jitter is characteristic of automated malware C2 check-in.

cases.notes: Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols C2 Beaconing (T1071.001).

rule.description: Firewall: single host contacted 200+ distinct ports on one destination in 60 seconds

ground_truth.expected_direction: Confirm whether the source is an authorized scanner, review which ports answered, check for follow-on connection attempts to open services.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Network scanning is low severity reconnaissance unless followed by immediate exploitation attempts.

cases.notes: High-port-count connection pattern is network service scanning (T1046).

rule.description: Firewall: Outbound RDP session initiated from standard workstation to foreign external IP

ground_truth.expected_direction: Terminate outbound TCP 3389 session; review local mstsc.exe process history and saved RDP credentials on workstation 10.0.1.33; interview logged-in user.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Workstations initiating outbound RDP to non-organizational public IPs suggest interactive unauthorized remote access.

cases.notes: Remote Services: Remote Desktop Protocol (T1021.001).

rule.description: Windows: 7-Zip command-line utility used to create password-protected archive of sensitive directories

ground_truth.expected_direction: Seize finance_q2.7z from C:\Users\Public; verify whether any upload activity occurred from win-fin-05; review network proxy logs for cloud storage destinations.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Command-line compression with encryption flags staging business records in public directories is an exfiltration precursor.

cases.notes: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility (T1560.001).

rule.description: Proxy: Large volume file upload (12 GB) to unapproved personal cloud storage service

ground_truth.expected_direction: Block mega.nz at proxy; interview t.adams; review endpoint forensic logs on 10.0.1.55 to determine which specific files were uploaded.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Multi-gigabyte uploads to unauthorized cloud storage indicate high-risk data leakage or intellectual property theft.

cases.notes: Exfiltration to Cloud Storage (T1567.002).

rule.description: Linux: scp command executed transferring database dump to foreign IP

ground_truth.expected_direction: Block communication to 198.51.100.222; immediately inspect postgres database server; initiate data breach incident response procedure; check database audit logs.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Direct transmission of database backups to an external server constitutes an active high-impact data exfiltration event.

cases.notes: Exfiltration Over Asymmetric Encrypted Non-C2 Protocol via SCP (T1048.002).

rule.description: Windows: Non-standard background process repeatedly monitoring clipboard API

ground_truth.expected_direction: Terminate clipmon.exe; analyze binary in sandbox to see if it exfiltrates captured text; advise user alex.dev to reset passwords copied into clipboard.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Clipboard sniffing utilities intercept copied credentials, API keys, and sensitive tokens.

cases.notes: Clipboard Data Collection (T1115).

rule.description: Web: Apache Log4j JNDI lookup exploit attempt detected in HTTP headers (CVE-2021-44228)

ground_truth.expected_direction: Verify if Java backend on app-prod-02 has Log4j vulnerability patched; inspect egress firewall logs for outbound LDAP traffic to port 1389; isolate host if outbound connection succeeded.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Exploitation of Log4Shell provides pre-auth unauthenticated remote code execution with maximum CVSS 10.0 impact.

cases.notes: Exploit Public-Facing Application: Apache Log4j2 JNDI RCE (T1190, CVE-2021-44228).

rule.description: Web server: suspicious .jsp file upload to webroot followed by HTTP POST requests to the uploaded file

ground_truth.expected_direction: Quarantine/remove the uploaded file, review webserver logs for source activity, check process executions spawned by the app server user, look for additional webshells.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: A webshell placed in webroot grants persistent interactive shell access through normal web protocols.

cases.notes: Server-side webshell behavior (T1505.003) following web app exploitation (T1190).

rule.description: Web: SQL injection pattern detected in HTTP GET parameters

ground_truth.expected_direction: Determine whether application returned HTTP 200 with extracted database content; apply parameterized queries / prepared statements; block source IP 203.0.113.111.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Successful SQL injection enables unauthorized extraction of entire relational database tables.

cases.notes: Exploit Public-Facing Application: SQL Injection (T1190).

rule.description: Web: Directory / Path Traversal attempt targeting sensitive system files

ground_truth.expected_direction: Confirm web server properly blocked request with HTTP 403/404; audit input sanitization on view endpoint; correlate other scanning from 198.51.100.15.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Path traversal attempt was blocked (HTTP 403) so threat impact is contained, justifying medium severity.

cases.notes: Exploit Public-Facing Application: Path Traversal (T1190).

rule.description: Windows: Executable file written with double extension deceptive naming

ground_truth.expected_direction: Quarantine the double-extension file immediately; check whether user double-clicked to execute; retrieve email logs to find delivery sender.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Double extension (.pdf.exe) is an intentional social engineering technique to deceive users into launching malware.

cases.notes: Masquerading: Double File Extension (T1036.007).

rule.description: Windows: Execution of hidden binary stored in NTFS Alternate Data Stream

ground_truth.expected_direction: Extract and inspect stream contents from notes.txt:payload.exe; kill child process spawned by WMIC; inspect how the NTFS stream was originally written.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Using NTFS Alternate Data Streams hides binaries from standard directory listings and casual user inspection.

cases.notes: Hide Artifacts: NTFS File Attributes / Alternate Data Streams (T1564.004).

rule.description: Windows: Known vulnerable kernel driver loaded (Bring Your Own Vulnerable Driver)

ground_truth.expected_direction: Unload vulnerable driver immediately; inspect kernel memory integrity; review which local process executed sc.exe or driver loader; enable Windows Defender Application Control (WDAC) driver blocklist.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Loading vulnerable signed drivers (BYOVD) allows adversaries to disable EDR agents and execute arbitrary code in ring 0.

cases.notes: Exploitation for Privilege Escalation: BYOVD (T1068).

rule.description: Windows: Bulk access and staging of KeePass password databases and SSH private keys

ground_truth.expected_direction: Remove C:\PerfLogs\loot staging folder; revoke and regenerate SSH keys found in staging; force password reset for user jdoe; isolate workstation.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Harvesting password vaults and SSH private keys into hidden staging folders precedes credential compromise across the environment.

cases.notes: Data Staged: Local Data Staging and Unsecured Credentials (T1074.001, T1552.001).

rule.description: Firewall: Port scan detected from authorized internal security vulnerability scanner

ground_truth.expected_direction: Cross-reference change ticket CHG-2026-9921 in change management system; verify scanner IP matches registered vulnerability management host 10.10.99.5; close alert as expected scheduled benign activity.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Source is an authorized vulnerability scanner running during scheduled maintenance window with registered change ticket CHG-2026-9921.
ground_truth.benign_rationale: Approved vulnerability scanning activity that should be filtered as a negative control.

cases.notes: Negative control: Authorized internal security scanner (benign).

rule.description: Linux: High volume data transfer to internal NFS storage server by backup daemon

ground_truth.expected_direction: Confirm backup job completion status in Veeam backup console; no remedial action necessary; dismiss alert as routine operational backup.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Scheduled nightly incremental database snapshot transferred across dedicated private storage subnet.

cases.notes: Negative control: Routine internal backup service (benign).

rule.description: sshd: Accepted publickey for authorized developer from corporate workstation

ground_truth.expected_direction: Verify key fingerprint matches d.miller developer credentials; normal development repository operation; no action required.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Standard developer git fetch/clone operation over SSH authenticated via corporate hardware token.
ground_truth.benign_rationale: Normal engineering productivity workflow with zero indicators of compromise.

cases.notes: Negative control: Developer public-key SSH git checkout (benign).

rule.description: Windows: Microsoft signed PowerShell script executed during maintenance window

ground_truth.expected_direction: Verify Windows Update client status; confirm script is catalog signed by Microsoft Windows Component Publisher; no intervention required.
ground_truth.severity_rationale: Cryptographically signed system update utility running with restricted execution policy during overnight maintenance window.

cases.notes: Negative control: Microsoft signed Windows Update execution (benign).
